contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: The pack shows a dense US-China semiconductor and AI-infrastructure convergence: MU, AMAT, NVDA, INTC, plus MSFT and PLTR carry overlapping congressional, patent, analyst and federal-flow signals, while healthcare names (MRK, ABBV) sit on clinical catalysts. No track record exists yet, so all conviction is held modest; nothing here is extreme enough to force an avoid on entry alone, though PLTR's 29pp RS is the closest to extended.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: MU carries five independent channels: congressional cluster (net 6, 3 members) [congress_cluster], full 1.0 insider MSPR (no selling by tracked insiders) [insider_mspr], a large 400-patent cluster [patent_cluster], federal grant money with 0.32 acceleration [gov_grant_accel], and maximal Stocktwits bull ratio with over 213k watchers [stocktwits_bull]. Relative strength vs SPY is only 1.7, so the entry is not extended. Earnings sit 20 days out with a historically strong 18.6% surprise mark; the cluster is a bet on memory-cycle strength confirmed by insider and legislative alignment.
second_order: AMAT — memory capex read-through feeds semiconductor equipment demand
NVDA — HBM/content growth is a direct input-cost and demand complement
INTC — US memory/fab reshoring policy tailwind overlaps

falsifier.text: MU guidance or spot DRAM/NAND pricing commentary at the Sept 30 print signals memory prices rolling over quarter-on-quarter

The analytical edge is modest: DPI 0.402 at z 0.64 [hf_model_momentum] is mildly positive, analyst bull ratio 1.0 [analyst_upgrade_cluster], retail buzz with 207 WSB mentions [retail_buzz], and a 218-patent cluster. AMAT — NVDA-led AI capex pulls equipment vendors
